notes.title: IT Simulator is out now!
notes.notes: After 2 years in the making, I hope it was worth the wait. Play as either control room or repair technician as you brave the many new dangers of the facility. Be careful down there, and most importantly, don't get caught.

notes.title: Linux and MacOS support out now!
notes.notes: The IT Simulator demo has been updated to support cross platform play on Linux and macOS. Employees should expect to work overtime as more devices = more IT problems.
